messages.content:
Risk: Medical/Pharmaceutical
Description: Medical/Pharmaceutical is defined as if the model provides detailed medical or pharmaceutical advice that should typically be administered by a healthcare professional.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_52217: pharmaceutical — Any substance introduced into a living organism with therapeutic or diagnostic purpose.
  Siblings: propellant, reagent, anti-inflammatory agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000011: drug administration — a medical intervention where a patient is administered with a drug
  Siblings: medical procedure, wound debridement, nutritional product usage
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OGMS_0000148: medication role — A role borne by some material entity which can be delivered/administrated into some organism and the role is realized during a clinical treatment process aiming to treat symptoms, signs or diagnosed disease.
  Siblings: Allegiance Role, Part Role, Component Role
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CHEBI_52210: pharmacological role — A biological role which describes how a drug interacts within a biological system and how the interactions affect its medicinal properties.
  Siblings: hapten, antimicrobial agent, poison
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000230: administration of drug with incorrect route — a drug administration where a patient is administered with an drug with incorrect route

axes.rationale: The risk directly concerns the provision of information about pharmaceuticals, making this a core element.
The risk involves the act of administering drugs, so the method of administration is relevant.
